Interface VirtualServerRmi

All Superinterfaces:
Remote, VirtualServer
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiServer
public interface VirtualServerRmi extends VirtualServer, Remote
Remote interface representing the server exposed to RMI clients. It extends VirtualServer to include core game actions and Remote to allow remote invocations.
